nodes.label: Node Engine
nodes.rationale: Flexible learning graph combining Notion + LMS + Testbook. Everything is a node: Exam, Year, Tier, Subject, Chapter, Topic, Test, Quiz, AI path. ONE TABLE handles ALL.

nodes.label: nodes Table (Core Schema)
nodes.rationale: Core engine table: BIGSERIAL id, public_id UUID, type TEXT, title, slug, parent_id BIGINT (self-ref ON DELETE CASCADE), meta JSONB default '{}', is_active, timestamps. UNIQUE(parent_id, slug).

nodes.label: Node Performance Indexes
nodes.rationale: Critical indexes: idx_nodes_parent, idx_nodes_type, idx_nodes_slug, idx_nodes_parent_slug, idx_nodes_public_id for hierarchical lookups.

nodes.label: Hybrid ID Architecture
nodes.rationale: Internal BIGSERIAL id for joins/foreign keys/performance. External public_id UUID for APIs/frontend/security. Human slug for URLs. Rejected integer-only for external and UUID as primary key.

nodes.label: Hierarchy Model (Exam Tree)
nodes.rationale: Exam > Session > Stage > Category > Subcategory > Test. Stored as self-referencing tree via parent_id. Example: SSC CGL > 2026 > Tier 1 > Quant > Algebra > Mock Test 1.

nodes.label: createNode Function
nodes.rationale: Async node insert: takes {type, title, slug, parentId, meta}, INSERT INTO nodes ... RETURNING *.

nodes.label: resolvePath Function
nodes.rationale: Walks down slug array to find target node. Uses (slug = $1 AND parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) for NULL-safe parent matching.

nodes.label: Recursive Tree CTE
nodes.rationale: WITH RECURSIVE tree: starts at id, UNION ALL joins children via parent_id. Returns entire subtree.

nodes.label: Catch-all URL Route
nodes.rationale: router.get('/*') splits path into slugs, calls resolvePath, returns 404 or {id, type, title, slug, meta}. Supports arbitrary depth like /ssc-cgl/2026/tier-1/quant/algebra/mock-1.

nodes.label: Node Types (Extensible Enum)
nodes.rationale: exam, session, stage, category, subcategory, subject, chapter, topic, test, quiz, ai_path, revision_plan. New types added without schema change.

nodes.label: Meta System (JSONB)
nodes.rationale: JSONB field on nodes for arbitrary attributes (difficulty, tags, duration, questions, ai_generated). Eliminates schema migrations for new properties.

nodes.label: Redis Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cache keys: node:<slug>, node:<path>, tree:<node_id>. Claims 90% faster navigation and reduces recursive DB calls.

nodes.label: Slug Per Parent Uniqueness
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(parent_id, slug) constraint. Allows ssc-cgl/2025 and ssc-cgl/2026 (different parents) but forbids two children with same slug under same parent. Rejected numeric suffix patterns like ssc-cgl-2.

nodes.label: Node Engine V1 (Structure)
nodes.rationale: Static graph: nodes, hierarchy, slugs, structure only. Foundation layer.

nodes.label: Node Engine V2 (Intelligence Layer)
nodes.rationale: Dynamic intelligence graph. Adds ai_meta JSONB to nodes (difficulty_score, mastery_score, attempt_count, correct_rate, avg_time, discrimination_index, forgetting_curve, recommendation_weight) and user_node_skill table.

nodes.label: Node Engine V3 (AI Tutor)
nodes.rationale: Conversation + Teaching AI. Per-node AI Tutor Instance, ai_tutor_memory table, Socratic teaching, mistake analyzer, adaptive teaching mode.

nodes.label: Node Engine V4 (Autonomous Education System)
nodes.rationale: Autonomous Teacher + Curriculum Builder + Examiner + Analyst. Adds curriculum_nodes, ai_generated_questions, exam_simulations tables. Modules: Curriculum Engine, Content Generator, Exam Simulator, Prediction Engine, Learning Optimizer. Self-improving feedback loop.

nodes.label: Node Engine V5 (AGI Education System)
nodes.rationale: Autonomous Education AGI. Adds education_world_state, agi_generated_exams, micro_skills tables. Modules: World Model Engine, Exam Generation AGI, Curriculum Evolution AGI, Student Population Simulator, Self-Reflection Engine, AGI Decision Engine.

nodes.label: Node Engine V6 (Multi-Agent Education Civilization)
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent civilization: Student Agents (skill vectors, learning strategies), Teacher Agents (teaching styles, effectiveness), Knowledge Economy (skills=currency, demand=value, mastery=wealth), Exam Events. Meta Governor controls balance.

nodes.label: ai_meta JSONB Structure
nodes.rationale: Per-node AI fields: difficulty_score, mastery_score, attempt_count, correct_rate, avg_time, discrimination_index, last_attempted_at, forgetting_curve {strength, decay}, recommendation_weight.

nodes.label: user_node_skill Table
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node mastery tracking: mastery_score FLOAT 0-1, confidence_score FLOAT, attempt_count, correct_count, last_attempted_at. UNIQUE(user_id, node_id).

nodes.label: ai_tutor_memory Table
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node tutor memory: conversation JSONB, last_context, knowledge_gaps, emotional_state, updated_at. UNIQUE(user_id, node_id).

nodes.label: curriculum_nodes Table
nodes.rationale: AI-generated curriculum: exam_id reference, topic, weightage, importance_score, predicted_questions, source ('ai_generated'|'manual'), meta JSONB.

nodes.label: ai_generated_questions Table
nodes.rationale: AI-created questions: node_id, question, options JSONB, answer, difficulty, prediction_score, explanation, source.

nodes.label: exam_simulations Table
nodes.rationale: Predicted exam outcomes: user_id, exam_id, score_predicted, rank_predicted, weak_topics JSONB, strong_topics JSONB.

nodes.label: education_world_state Table
nodes.rationale: V5 global state: global_skill_graph JSONB, difficulty_landscape, exam_evolution, student_distribution, system_insights, updated_at.

nodes.label: agi_generated_exams Table
nodes.rationale: Exams created by AGI: exam_name, pattern JSONB, questions JSONB, difficulty_curve, predicted_success_rate.

nodes.label: micro_skills Table
nodes.rationale: Evolved skills catalog: name, parent_skill, difficulty, emergence_score (novelty/importance).

nodes.label: calculateMastery Function
nodes.rationale: accuracy = correct/total; mastery = min(1, accuracy * speedPenalty). Used by tutor and recommendation engines.

nodes.label: updateDifficulty Function
nodes.rationale: node.ai_meta.difficulty_score = 1 - correctRate. Harder when fewer correct.

nodes.label: getRecommendationScore Function
nodes.rationale: priority = (1-mastery)*0.5 + difficulty*0.3 + freshness*0.2. Surfaces weak/forgotten/high-impact topics.

nodes.label: shouldRevise Function
nodes.rationale: Forgetting curve: shouldRevise = daysSince > 1 / (mastery + 0.1).

nodes.label: askTutor Function
nodes.rationale: Core AI tutor entry: load node, memory, userSkill; build prompt; call LLM; persist conversation to memory.

nodes.label: buildTutorPrompt Function
nodes.rationale: Builds Socratic prompt with topic, type, mastery, weak areas, last 5 conversation turns, and rules: diagnose before teach, then example, then practice.

nodes.label: generateCurriculum Function
nodes.rationale: Aggregates past papers, analyzes topic frequency, maps to {topic, weightage, importance_score, predicted_questions}.

nodes.label: generateLearningPath Function
nodes.rationale: Scores all child nodes via getRecommendationScore and sorts descending; output is adaptive path.

nodes.label: generateAdaptiveTest Function
nodes.rationale: Builds test from user's weakNodes; weights question pools by (1 - mastery).

nodes.label: predictRank Function
nodes.rationale: percentile = userScore/maxScore; rank = totalCandidates * (1 - percentile). Estimates rank from predicted score.

nodes.label: simulateExam Function
nodes.rationale: Combines weakAreas + calculateExpectedScore + estimateRank; returns {score, rank, weak_topics}.

nodes.label: updateSystemFromResults Function
nodes.rationale: Feedback loop core: updates node difficulty, question quality, curriculum weights based on student performance.

nodes.label: AGI_decide Function
nodes.rationale: V5 core brain: analyzes world state, decides whether to update curriculum, generate new exam pattern, increase difficulty, introduce new skills, retrain tutor models.

nodes.label: analyzeMistake Function
nodes.rationale: Classifies wrong answer into {error_type: conceptual|calculation|careless, concept_gap, severity, suggestion}.

nodes.label: AI Tutor Engine
nodes.rationale: Teaching brain: Socratic Teaching Model, step-by-step explanations, misconception detection, adaptive hints. Composed of askTutor + buildTutorPrompt + analyzeMistake.

nodes.label: Curriculum Engine (Syllabus Brain)
nodes.rationale: Exam pattern analyzer, topic frequency extractor, weightage calculator, dynamic syllabus builder. Composed of generateCurriculum + curriculum_nodes.

nodes.label: Question Generator (Content Brain)
nodes.rationale: Exam-style question creation, difficulty calibration, trap generation, explanation generator. Backed by ai_generated_questions + generateAIQuestion.

nodes.label: Exam Simulation Engine (Reality Brain)
nodes.rationale: Full mock exams, time pressure simulation, rank prediction, score forecasting. Composed of simulateExam + predictRank + exam_simulations.

nodes.label: Learning Optimizer (Adaptive Brain)
nodes.rationale: Weakness detection, skill graph updates, adaptive learning path, revision scheduling.

nodes.label: Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: Identifies weak topics, forgotten topics, high-impact topics via getRecommendationScore + getTimeDecay.

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition Engine
nodes.rationale: Forgetting curve logic: triggers revision when retention decays below threshold.

nodes.label: Mistake Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Every wrong answer becomes structured data: error_type, concept_gap, severity, suggestion. Drives personalized lesson generation.

nodes.label: World Model Engine (Education Simulator)
nodes.rationale: V5 module: models student population distribution, full-system skill graph, difficulty landscape, exam ecosystem, knowledge dependencies. Enables future exam prediction (e.g. 'what SSC will ask in 2027').

nodes.label: Exam Generation AGI (Exam Authority Engine)
nodes.rationale: V5 module: creates entire exams from scratch, defines marking schemes, designs difficulty curves, generates paper patterns, evolves exams over time. Simulated, not authoritative.

nodes.label: Curriculum Evolution AGI
nodes.rationale: V5 module: removes outdated topics, adds emerging patterns, reweights importance dynamically, creates new micro-skills.

nodes.label: Student Population Simulator
nodes.rationale: V5 module: simulates millions of learners, predicts rank distribution, identifies bottlenecks, detects learning collapse points.

nodes.label: Self-Reflection Engine
nodes.rationale: V5 module: analyzes system performance, detects inefficiencies, rewrites own teaching logic, improves curriculum and exams.

nodes.label: AGI Decision Engine
nodes.rationale: Autonomous control center: decides when to teach, when to test, when to revise, when to increase difficulty, when to simulate exam. Driven by AGI_decide function.

nodes.label: Meta Governor
nodes.rationale: V6 AGI control layer: controls curriculum evolution, difficulty scaling, agent spawning, system balance.

nodes.label: Knowledge Economy
nodes.rationale: V6 conceptual layer: skills are currency, demand is value system, mastery is wealth.

nodes.label: Socratic Teaching Method
nodes.rationale: Teaching style: don't give full answer; diagnose misunderstanding first, then teach concept, then similar example, then practice question.

nodes.label: Forgetting Curve Model
nodes.rationale: Per-node forgetting strength + decay parameters. Drives shouldRevise threshold and recommendation freshness component.

nodes.label: Self-Improving Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Student Activity -> Performance Analyzer -> Learning Optimizer -> Curriculum Regenerator -> Question Regeneration -> AI Tutor Adaptation -> back to student. What makes V4 'autonomous'.

nodes.label: Education World Model
nodes.rationale: V5 meta-architecture: models Students, Knowledge, Exams, Institutions, Difficulty Space, Global Performance Distribution.

nodes.label: Multi-Layer Tutor System
nodes.rationale: Five-level per-node tutor: Explain, Diagnose, Train, Test, Revise.

nodes.label: AI Orchestration Engine
nodes.rationale: V4 brain layer: Intent Router, Context Builder, Memory Retriever, Tool Selector. Coordinates Tutor/Curriculum/QA/Exam/Memory subsystems.

nodes.label: Supabase RLS Permissive Policy Issue
nodes.rationale: Original trigger: overly permissive RLS policies using WITH CHECK (true) and USING (true) on discussion_replies, doubt_replies, doubts, question_discussions. Effectively bypassed INSERT security.

hyperedges.rationale: V4 autonomous feedback loop: Performance Analyzer -> Learning Optimizer (update skill graph, adjust difficulty) -> Curriculum Regenerator (reweight syllabus) -> Question Regeneration (new questions) -> AI Tutor Adaptation (teaching style, hints) -> back to Student.

V5 loop: Global Learning Data -> World Model Simulation -> Exam Generation AGI -> Student Performance System -> Curriculum Evolution AGI -> Self-Reflection Engine -> loops back. Driven by AGI_decide function.
V6 civilization: Agents interact -> Exams occur -> Performance analyzed -> Knowledge economy updates -> Agents evolve -> Meta Governor balances system. Multi-agent education civilization.
